metadata.Syllabus Name: Working with Spring Framework_Làm việc với Spring Framework
metadata.Learning-Teaching Method: Project based learning,Problem based learning,Active learning,In-class lecture
metadata.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 145-minute final exam + 102,6h self-study
metadata.Description: Upon completion of this course students shoud: 1. Understand the followings: • Basic concepts of Java FX to build Desktop Application • Basics of Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) with JPA and how it simplifies database interactions. • Spring Framework, Spring Boot, which provides a comprehensive ecosystem for building enterprise-level applications. • Spring Framework's dependency injection, and web frameworks to build robust and scalable applications 2. Be able to: • Use JPA ORM tool to map Java objects to database tables. • Use Spring Framework's dependency injection, and web frameworks to build robust and scalable applications. • Develop Cross-platform Desktop applications and support for user experience (UI & UX) 3. Be able to work in team and present group's results
metadata.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
metadata.Tools: - Internet - IntelliJ IDEA - Platform : Java Development Kit 21 - Scene Builder 23

sections.heading: Syllabus Details
rows: Working with Spring Framework_Làm việc với Spring Framework
Project based learning,Problem based learning,Active learning,In-class lecture
Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 145-minute final exam + 102,6h self-study

Upon completion of this course students shoud: 1. Understand the followings: • Basic concepts of Java FX to build Desktop Application • Basics of Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) with JPA and how it simplifies database interactions. • Spring Framework, Spring Boot, which provides a comprehensive ecosystem for building enterprise-level applications. • Spring Framework's dependency injection, and web frameworks to build robust and scalable applications 2. Be able to: • Use JPA ORM tool to map Java objects to database tables. • Use Spring Framework's dependency injection, and web frameworks to build robust and scalable applications. • Develop Cross-platform Desktop applications and support for user experience (UI & UX) 3. Be able to work in team and present group's results

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
- Internet - IntelliJ IDEA - Platform : Java Development Kit 21 - Scene Builder 23

sections.heading: 6 LO(s)
rows: Describe the basics of Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) and how it simplifies database interactions.
Describe the concepts of Spring Framework and Spring Boot
Describe how Spring Data working with various data sources
Undersatnd Spring MVC provides a comprehensive programming and configuration model for modern Java-based enterprise applications.
Create Cross-Platform applications using JavaFX. JavaFX is platform-independent, which means that JavaFX applications (CRUD) can run on different operating systems such as Windows, macOS, and Linux
Develop teamwork skills, communication skills (including presentation skills)
